title: Project Estimator
descriptionHtml:
Project Estimator

About Us

​

We’re a team that takes pride in our work and our people. With a strong focus on service, quality, and the health and well-being of our team, we’re looking to add someone who shares these values and brings positive energy, accountability, and a team-first mindset to the workplace.

​

Position Overview

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented team member to join our Estimating Team. This role supports our sales team by producing accurate material takeoffs from construction plans and blueprints, helping projects move efficiently from planning to execution. While we provide training and development, candidates with experience in metal roofing, construction, manufacturing, or estimating will feel right at home. The ideal candidate enjoys problem-solving, values accuracy, and wants to be part of a winning team that treats people with trust and respect.

​

Key Responsibilities

  • Create accurate material lists from blueprints and construction plans

  • Support the sales team with fast, reliable turnaround times on estimates

  • Review drawings to identify materials, quantities, and project requirements

  • Communicate clearly with internal teams to ensure accuracy and alignment

  • Manage multiple estimates while meeting deadlines

  • Maintain organized and structured documentation

  • Contribute to a collaborative, team-focused work environment
     

Requirements

  • Strong basic math and geometry skills
    Effective time management and organizational abilities

  • Clear and professional communication skills

  • Ability to work accurately in a fast-paced environment

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Valid driver’s license

  • Reliable attendance and a strong sense of accountability
     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in metal roofing, metal manufacturing, construction, or building materials

  • Familiarity with reading blueprints and construction documents

  • Previous estimating or takeoff experience

  • Experience with estimating software or construction-related technology

​

Why Join Us?

  • Supportive, team-first culture built on trust, respect, uprightness, and excellence

  • Emphasis on safety, health, and overall well-being

  • Hands-on training, coaching, and advancement opportunities

  • Opportunity to grow with a company that values hard work and dedication

  • Clean, well-organized facility with modern systems and tools

title: Customer Relationship Manager
descriptionHtml:
Customer Relationship Manager

​About Us​

At True Metal Supply, we believe in building lasting relationships—both with our customers and within our team. Our culture is built on trust, respect, uprightness, and excellence, and we’re looking for someone who embodies these values in everything they do. If you’re a highly motivated, personable, and driven sales professional who thrives on connecting with people, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

​

About the Role

As an Customer Relationship Manager, you’ll be the face of our company, forging meaningful connections with clients, uncovering their needs, and delivering top-tier solutions. You will be responsible for growing and maintaining a strong client base, closing deals, and ensuring customer satisfaction while upholding the values that define our company culture.

​

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • A Positive Attitude: You bring energy, optimism, and a can-do spirit to every challenge

  • A Natural People Person: You genuinely enjoy meeting new people and building relationships

  • Highly Motivated & Goal-Oriented: You set ambitious goals and take action to achieve them

  • Trustworthy & Honest: You operate with integrity, always doing what’s right for the customer and the company

  • Resilient & Coachable: You see feedback as an opportunity to grow and improve

  • Self-Starter: You thrive in an environment where you manage your own schedule and sales pipeline

  • Excellent Communicator: You can convey value clearly, persuasively, and confidently


Why Join Us?

  • A supportive, team-oriented culture where your success is celebrated

  • Ongoing training and professional development to help you grow

  • Competitive salary with Comprehensive benefit (health, retirement, etc.)

  • The opportunity to be part of a company that truly values trust, respect, and excellence

​

If you’re ready to take your sales career to the next level while being part of a team that feels like family, we want to hear from you! Apply today and let’s build something great together.

​

​

​

title: Delivery Driver
descriptionHtml:
Delivery Driver

About Us:

We’re a team that takes pride in our work and our people. With a strong focus on service, quality, and the health and well-being of our team, we’re looking to add someone who shares these values, takes pride in being the face of a company, and brings a positive energy to the workplace. Are you ready to raise the bar and deliver excellence with every load?

 

Position Overview:
Are you looking for a reliable, satisfying, and fun place to work? Do you love driving, meeting new people, and working with a team that feels like family? If so, we want YOU to join our team as a Delivery Driver!
 

Key Responsibilities:
● Safely operate Brand New RAM 3500 flatbed with bumper pull trailer
● Deliver goods to happy customers on time with a smile.
● Load/unload deliveries and assist with basic logistics.
● Provide outstanding customer service – because YOU are the face of our company!
● Keep the vehicle clean and in good condition.
● Work as part of an amazing, hardworking team.
● Assist with production and warehouse duties during downtime and between deliveries.
Requirements:
● A valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
● A positive, can-do attitude.
● Ability to lift and move packages (some heavy lifting may be required).
● Strong communication and customer service skills.
● Ability to pull a 26'; trailer with a flat bed super duty pickup truck
 

Why Join Us:
● No CDL Required – Just a great attitude and a valid driver’s license!
● Fun, Positive Environment – We believe work should be enjoyable.
● Dependable & Supportive Team – We’ve got your back!
● Consistent & Satisfying Work – Every day brings something new.
● Opportunities to Grow – We invest in our people!
 

Ready to make every delivery count?
Apply now and join a team that values safety, quality, professionalism, and enthusiasm. We don’t just deliver metal—we deliver excellence.

title: Warehouse Assoc.
descriptionHtml:
Warehouse Assoc.

About Us: 

We’re a team that takes pride in our work and our people. With a strong focus on service, quality, and the health and well-being of our team, we’re looking to add someone who shares these values and brings a positive energy to the workplace.

 

Job Overview: 

We are seeking a smart, focused, and motivated Material Handler to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. This role is crucial in ensuring smooth operations by managing inventory, handling materials safely, and coordinating with different departments to maintain workflow efficiency.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Receive, inspect, and store incoming materials and supplies.

  • Accurately pick, pack, and distribute materials to the appropriate departments.

  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other warehouse equipment safely.

  • Keep work areas clean and organized to promote efficiency and safety.

 

Requirements:

  • Ability to lift heavy objects (up to 50lbs) and stand for extended periods.

  • A proactive mindset with a strong work ethic and problem-solving abilities.

  • Forklift certification is a plus (or willingness to obtain).

 

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Opportunities for career growth and development.

  • Supportive and team-oriented work environment.

  • A company that values innovation, efficiency, and employee well-being.

If you are a driven and detail-oriented individual looking for a rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply and become part of our dynamic team!

title: Asheville Facility Manager
descriptionHtml:
Asheville Facility Manager

​About Us​

We’re a team that takes pride in our work and our people. With a strong focus on service, quality, and the health and well-being of our team, we’re looking to add someone who shares these values and brings a positive energy to the workplace.
​

About the Role

The Facility Manager plays a key leadership role in overseeing daily operations, ensuring the facility runs safely, efficiently, and profitably. This position is responsible for driving production, supporting sales goals, maintaining quality standards, and leading a team that reflects our core values. We’re looking for someone who is hands-on, accountable, and motivated to build a strong team while delivering excellent service and results.
​

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support the team while modeling and enforcing company core values

  • Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure all protocols are followed consistently

  • Oversee daily production to ensure all orders are completed accurately and on time

  • Ensure all orders are properly produced, loaded, and delivered to quality standards

  • Drive performance to meet or exceed sales and gross margin goals

  • Manage team scheduling and assist with controlling labor costs, including overtime

  • Identify and reduce operational inefficiencies, including $0.00 invoices and second deliveries

  • Uphold high customer service standards that lead to consistent, positive feedback and reviews

  • Support team development, accountability, and overall job satisfaction

 

Requirements: 

  • 2+ years of leadership or management experience in a production, warehouse, or operations environment

  • Strong understanding of safety standards and ability to enforce them consistently

  • Proven ability to manage teams, schedules, and daily operations effectively

  • Experience with production workflows, order fulfillment, or logistics preferred

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, hands-on environment

  • Valid driver’s license


Why Join Us?

  • Supportive, team-first culture.

  • Emphasis on safety, health, and well-being.​​

  • Opportunity to grow with a company that values hard work and dedication

  • Clean, well-organized facility with modern equipment.

​

​
